The amphibian displays characteristic glossy black skin with irregular, vivid yellow blotches and stripes along its back and limbs. The head is visible on the left, showing a broad shape, while the body extends towards the right, tapering into a tail that exits the frame. One forelimb and one hindlimb are clearly visible, planted on the rock.
